description: This file defines the TicTacToeViewModel class, which manages UI state for a Tic Tac Toe game, handles persistence across configuration changes, and interacts with the GameEngine and GameState classes.

classes.name: TicTacToeViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel managing the UI state for Tic Tac Toe game, including persistence and game actions.

classes.name: UiState
classes.description: Data class representing the UI state of the game, including board, current player, game over status, winner, outcome shown flag, and winner line.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles cell tap events, updates game state via GameEngine, and manages outcomeShown flag.

methods.name: onRestart
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game and resets relevant flags.

methods.name: markOutcomeShown
methods.description: Marks the game outcome as shown in the saved state.

methods.name: persistState
methods.description: Persists current game state to SavedStateHandle.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores game state from SavedStateHandle or resets if no saved state exists.
